conclusion: Task-local retrieval is implemented and substantially smaller. The four-answer matched continuation improves official semantic scores but adds model calls, time and estimated solver cost; one new answer is malformed JSON. No general accuracy or cost improvement is established.
baseline: Previous implementation of our native ReAct agent, not DSGym or DS-Agent
implementation: Only selected answer branches; changed/introduced operators and affected downstream computations are local.
Unchanged earlier computations become pinned input references with owning task, operator ID, revision, result identity, availability and scope.
Boundary matching uses incoming computation fingerprints, the immediate preceding task and materialized result identities.
Selected expansion and original root samples never execute or read the current graph.
Missing answer roots stay unexpanded candidates; computed answers declare operator_ids.
Multi-task graph inspection requires operator_ids; single-task unscoped inspection remains available.
Generic prompt guidance explains reuse, scope checks, selective expansion, repair and historical versions.

replay.method: Identical captured graphs, root metadata, immutable result identities and original samples; compare archived and current renderers. No model or engine calls; does not measure solver accuracy or billed tokens.
replay.limitation: Same inspect requests, not same information. Unconfirmed candidates require a further selection call; sums do not include that additional call. Characters are not billed tokens, cost or accuracy.

pilot.seed_method: Replay the same recorded Task 1 actions and agent answer through each real engine without model calls. Both resulting graphs have identical 16 operator/computation fingerprints. Reference code/answers and benchmark dependency annotations were withheld from solver inputs.
pilot.attempt_policy: One continuation per arm, no solver retries or selective exclusions. All four answered; all costs included.
pilot.comparison_changes: Task representation, source-declaration guidance, task index and graph-inspection constraints change together. This is not an isolated representation ablation.
pilot.judge_protocol: Existing official LongDS binary question-focused prompt; score 1 passes. Same cached question/reference/answer judgments; no new grader or manual overrides.
